**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retain the sampled response bodies**

When this qualification is audited after the endpoint content changes, this prefix hash cannot be reproduced because only its digest, length, and first line are committed; the command wrote the actual bytes under `/tmp`, and a repository-wide search finds no retained copy for either 4 KiB sample. This makes the content evidence and the claimed independent hash verification non-reproducible, so retain the bounded response bytes alongside the JSON.
